catalog.title: Lucifer Chronicles: The Bulgarian Incident
catalog.description: A profane, cosmic support ticket through property, paperwork, cars, AI scope creep, and Hell.
catalog.contentNotice: Strong language, religious satire, dangerous-driving anecdotes, and recognizable parody.

strings.lucifer.ben_detour_coffee.return: Return to the case with this detail noted
strings.lucifer.ben_detour_coffee.text: Coffee arrives with an old apartment key beneath the saucer.
strings.lucifer.ben_detour_fly.return: Return to the case with this detail noted
strings.lucifer.ben_detour_fly.text: A fly lands on the deed and refuses to indicate which signature it supports.
strings.lucifer.ben_ending_house_fix.text:
The Guy Who Just Wanted to Fix a House

The roof holds. This modest fact defeats the entire cosmic apparatus.
strings.lucifer.ben_ending_the_builder.text:
The Builder

One quick question becomes an engine, a site, and a body of work that answers better questions.
strings.lucifer.ben_ending_the_bureaucrat.text:
The Bureaucrat

You master the forms without letting the forms explain you.
strings.lucifer.ben_ending_the_escapist.text:
The Escapist

You leave the queue, the house, and the metaphysics open in another tab.
strings.lucifer.ben_ending_the_observer.text:
The Observer

You stop demanding that every absurdity become a lesson and finally see the whole joke.
strings.lucifer.ben_final_choice.text: The story asks what you actually accomplished. This is an aggressive question.
strings.lucifer.ben_hell_1.escalate: Escalate through the least appropriate channel
strings.lucifer.ben_hell_1.observe: Observe one detail everyone else missed
strings.lucifer.ben_hell_1.text: At 3 AM, insomnia upgrades into a full philosophical debate in Hell.
strings.lucifer.ben_hell_1_literal.text: He has been waiting for the Bulgarian.
strings.lucifer.ben_hell_2.escalate: Escalate through the least appropriate channel
strings.lucifer.ben_hell_2.observe: Observe one detail everyone else missed
strings.lucifer.ben_hell_2.text: Lucifer asks why you keep calling yourself Lucifer online.
strings.lucifer.ben_hell_2_literal.text: He regrets asking with admirable speed.
strings.lucifer.ben_hell_3.escalate: Escalate through the least appropriate channel
strings.lucifer.ben_hell_3.observe: Observe one detail everyone else missed
strings.lucifer.ben_hell_3.text: Alan Watts pours tea. Neo refuses a mission. An Agent opens a ticket that cannot be categorized.
strings.lucifer.ben_hell_3_literal.text: Lucifer says no one invited symbolism.
strings.lucifer.ben_hell_4.escalate: Escalate through the least appropriate channel
strings.lucifer.ben_hell_4.observe: Observe one detail everyone else missed
strings.lucifer.ben_hell_4.remember: Use what this story taught you earlier
strings.lucifer.ben_hell_4.text: God explains that humanity may have been designed primarily for comedic value.
strings.lucifer.ben_hell_5.escalate: Escalate through the least appropriate channel
strings.lucifer.ben_hell_5.observe: Observe one detail everyone else missed
strings.lucifer.ben_hell_5.remember: Use what this story taught you earlier
strings.lucifer.ben_hell_5.text: The final question is whether you fixed the house, escaped the office, or merely made the story better.
strings.lucifer.ben_house_fix.label: The Guy Who Just Wanted to Fix a House
strings.lucifer.ben_municipality_1.escalate: Escalate through the least appropriate channel
strings.lucifer.ben_municipality_1.observe: Observe one detail everyone else missed
strings.lucifer.ben_municipality_1.text: At 08:03, a note says the office is closed for a meeting until 11:30.
strings.lucifer.ben_municipality_1_absurd.text: The other entrance has a more authoritative note.
strings.lucifer.ben_municipality_2.escalate: Escalate through the least appropriate channel
strings.lucifer.ben_municipality_2.observe: Observe one detail everyone else missed
strings.lucifer.ben_municipality_2.text: The clerk reviews every document, smiles, and notices one is now too old.
strings.lucifer.ben_municipality_2_absurd.text: Room 14 is delighted to meet you.
strings.lucifer.ben_municipality_3.escalate: Escalate through the least appropriate channel
strings.lucifer.ben_municipality_3.observe: Observe one detail everyone else missed
strings.lucifer.ben_municipality_3.text: Room 14 sends you to Room 6. Room 6 sends you to Room 14.
strings.lucifer.ben_municipality_3_absurd.text: The supervisor is temporarily in Room 14.
strings.lucifer.ben_municipality_4.escalate: Escalate through the least appropriate channel
strings.lucifer.ben_municipality_4.observe: Observe one detail everyone else missed
strings.lucifer.ben_municipality_4.remember: Use what this story taught you earlier
strings.lucifer.ben_municipality_4.text: The guard suggests coffee, the mayor’s cousin, and not asking questions in that order.
strings.lucifer.ben_municipality_4_literal.text: The coffee knows more than the registry.
strings.lucifer.ben_municipality_5.escalate: Escalate through the least appropriate channel
strings.lucifer.ben_municipality_5.observe: Observe one detail everyone else missed
strings.lucifer.ben_municipality_5.remember: Use what this story taught you earlier
strings.lucifer.ben_municipality_5.text: Your paperwork now has enough stamps to qualify as a small religion.
strings.lucifer.ben_municipality_5_absurd.text: Lucifer receives a ticket with thirteen attachments.
strings.lucifer.ben_municipality_5_literal.text: The final form requests the previous final form.
strings.lucifer.ben_permission_1.escalate: Escalate through the least appropriate channel
strings.lucifer.ben_permission_1.observe: Observe one detail everyone else missed
strings.lucifer.ben_permission_1.text: Your aunt explains she owns everything because she maintained the tomatoes since 1998.
strings.lucifer.ben_permission_1_literal.text: The records exist in three offices and agree in none.
strings.lucifer.ben_permission_2.escalate: Escalate through the least appropriate channel
strings.lucifer.ben_permission_2.observe: Observe one detail everyone else missed
strings.lucifer.ben_permission_2.text: A family meeting begins peacefully and reaches 1994 in under twelve minutes.
strings.lucifer.ben_permission_2_literal.text: Silence is interpreted as a hostile legal position.
strings.lucifer.ben_permission_3.escalate: Escalate through the least appropriate channel
strings.lucifer.ben_permission_3.observe: Observe one detail everyone else missed
strings.lucifer.ben_permission_3.text: The disputed fence is measured by three people using three incompatible metres.
strings.lucifer.ben_permission_3_absurd.text: Vibes produce the same argument faster.
strings.lucifer.ben_permission_3_literal.text: The tape measure is accused of bias.
strings.lucifer.ben_permission_4.escalate: Escalate through the least appropriate channel
strings.lucifer.ben_permission_4.observe: Observe one detail everyone else missed
strings.lucifer.ben_permission_4.remember: Use what this story taught you earlier
strings.lucifer.ben_permission_4.text: A locked gate presents a choice between procedure and immediate regret.
strings.lucifer.ben_permission_4_literal.text: The key is in a drawer nobody owns.
strings.lucifer.ben_permission_5.escalate: Escalate through the least appropriate channel
strings.lucifer.ben_permission_5.observe: Observe one detail everyone else missed
strings.lucifer.ben_permission_5.remember: Use what this story taught you earlier
strings.lucifer.ben_permission_5.text: You finally obtain paperwork proving a fact everyone already knew yesterday.
strings.lucifer.ben_question_1.escalate: Escalate through the least appropriate channel
strings.lucifer.ben_question_1.observe: Observe one detail everyone else missed
strings.lucifer.ben_question_1.text: To solve the form problem, you ask an AI one innocent question about Jones in the Fast Lane.
strings.lucifer.ben_question_1_absurd.text: A game engine appears in the room.
strings.lucifer.ben_question_2.escalate: Escalate through the least appropriate channel
strings.lucifer.ben_question_2.observe: Observe one detail everyone else missed
strings.lucifer.ben_question_2.text: The engine needs documentation. The documentation needs a site. The site needs a publishing system.
strings.lucifer.ben_question_2_absurd.text: Lucifer writes ‘of course’ in the margin.
strings.lucifer.ben_question_2_literal.text: The boundary is converted into a roadmap.
strings.lucifer.ben_question_3.escalate: Escalate through the least appropriate channel
strings.lucifer.ben_question_3.observe: Observe one detail everyone else missed
strings.lucifer.ben_question_3.text: Someone asks whether you have a plan. You look at the arrows, containers, agents, and blogs.
strings.lucifer.ben_question_4.escalate: Escalate through the least appropriate channel
strings.lucifer.ben_question_4.observe: Observe one detail everyone else missed
strings.lucifer.ben_question_4.remember: Use what this story taught you earlier
strings.lucifer.ben_question_4.text: Forty-four work units later, the original question is still sitting there looking innocent.
strings.lucifer.ben_question_4_literal.text: The laptop opens a new issue.
strings.lucifer.ben_question_5.escalate: Escalate through the least appropriate channel
strings.lucifer.ben_question_5.observe: Observe one detail everyone else missed
strings.lucifer.ben_question_5.remember: Use what this story taught you earlier
strings.lucifer.ben_question_5.text: Future You has been notified. Future You has not replied.
strings.lucifer.ben_question_5_absurd.text: The coffee has not cooled yet.
strings.lucifer.ben_question_6.escalate: Escalate through the least appropriate channel
strings.lucifer.ben_question_6.observe: Observe one detail everyone else missed
strings.lucifer.ben_question_6.remember: Use what this story taught you earlier
strings.lucifer.ben_question_6.text: The system asks you to categorize the project. The available categories are all visibly inadequate.
strings.lucifer.ben_return_1.escalate: Escalate through the least appropriate channel
strings.lucifer.ben_return_1.observe: Observe one detail everyone else missed
strings.lucifer.ben_return_1.text: You return to Bulgaria intending to fix one house. Your estimate is two weeks. Reality has opened a fresh ticket.
strings.lucifer.ben_return_2.escalate: Escalate through the least appropriate channel
strings.lucifer.ben_return_2.observe: Observe one detail everyone else missed
strings.lucifer.ben_return_2.text: At the gate, a neighbour asks why you came back and recommends a cheaper mechanic before you answer.
strings.lucifer.ben_return_2_literal.text: He explains your own life back to you, incorrectly.
strings.lucifer.ben_return_3.escalate: Escalate through the least appropriate channel
strings.lucifer.ben_return_3.observe: Observe one detail everyone else missed
strings.lucifer.ben_return_3.text: The house is quiet, beautiful, and apparently co-owned by everyone who has ever touched a tomato.
strings.lucifer.ben_return_3_literal.text: A drawer produces documents and a spider with opinions.
strings.lucifer.ben_return_4.escalate: Escalate through the least appropriate channel
strings.lucifer.ben_return_4.observe: Observe one detail everyone else missed
strings.lucifer.ben_return_4.remember: Use what this story taught you earlier
strings.lucifer.ben_return_4.text: An email arrives granting you permission to live exactly where you have been living.
strings.lucifer.ben_return_4_absurd.text: Gravity has not requested permission either.
strings.lucifer.ben_return_5.escalate: Escalate through the least appropriate channel
strings.lucifer.ben_return_5.observe: Observe one detail everyone else missed
strings.lucifer.ben_return_5.remember: Use what this story taught you earlier
strings.lucifer.ben_return_5.text: You consider whether this is a property dispute or simply a very long joke with deeds.
strings.lucifer.ben_return_5_absurd.text: He says the help desk is aware.
strings.lucifer.ben_return_5_literal.text: The lawyer says ‘it depends’ with doctoral confidence.
strings.lucifer.ben_road_1.escalate: Escalate through the least appropriate channel
strings.lucifer.ben_road_1.observe: Observe one detail everyone else missed
strings.lucifer.ben_road_1.text: A black BMW blocks your lane. A van then parks behind it, improving nothing.
strings.lucifer.ben_road_1_absurd.text: A stranger discovers this is apparently aggression.
strings.lucifer.ben_road_1_literal.text: Patience becomes visible to the entire street.
strings.lucifer.ben_road_2.escalate: Escalate through the least appropriate channel
strings.lucifer.ben_road_2.observe: Observe one detail everyone else missed
strings.lucifer.ben_road_2.text: The driver asks whether you find the situation funny.
strings.lucifer.ben_road_2_absurd.text: This turns out to be less diplomatic and more honest.
strings.lucifer.ben_road_3.escalate: Escalate through the least appropriate channel
strings.lucifer.ben_road_3.observe: Observe one detail everyone else missed
strings.lucifer.ben_road_3.text: Your own dashboard lights up five minutes after inspection.
strings.lucifer.ben_road_3_absurd.text: The warning light becomes part of the sound system.
strings.lucifer.ben_road_3_literal.text: He says it was already like that.
strings.lucifer.ben_road_4.escalate: Escalate through the least appropriate channel
strings.lucifer.ben_road_4.observe: Observe one detail everyone else missed
strings.lucifer.ben_road_4.remember: Use what this story taught you earlier
strings.lucifer.ben_road_4.text: A mountain road remembers the old Evo and every bad decision that felt aerodynamic.
strings.lucifer.ben_road_4_absurd.text: Your brain starts pricing nearby land.
strings.lucifer.ben_road_5.escalate: Escalate through the least appropriate channel
strings.lucifer.ben_road_5.observe: Observe one detail everyone else missed
strings.lucifer.ben_road_5.remember: Use what this story taught you earlier
strings.lucifer.ben_road_5.text: The mechanic fixes a mysterious noise with a hammer and several words not found in dictionaries.
strings.lucifer.ben_road_5_absurd.text: He explains until language gives up.
strings.lucifer.ben_road_5_literal.text: Trust has become a maintenance schedule.
strings.lucifer.ben_seeded_detour.text: The universe selects a footnote without consulting the protagonist.

strings.lucifer.campaign.description: A sprawling, profane, philosophical trip through Bulgaria, bureaucracy, AI escalation, and Hell’s customer-support queue.
strings.lucifer.campaign.title: Lucifer Chronicles: The Bulgarian Incident
strings.lucifer.lucifer_audit_1.escalate: Escalate through the least appropriate channel
strings.lucifer.lucifer_audit_1.observe: Observe one detail everyone else missed
strings.lucifer.lucifer_audit_1.text: The municipality is closed for a meeting. The meeting is apparently eternal.
strings.lucifer.lucifer_audit_2.escalate: Escalate through the least appropriate channel
strings.lucifer.lucifer_audit_2.observe: Observe one detail everyone else missed
strings.lucifer.lucifer_audit_2.text: Room 14 sends you to Room 6. Room 6 sends you to Room 14. Even Hell respects this design.
strings.lucifer.lucifer_audit_3.escalate: Escalate through the least appropriate channel
strings.lucifer.lucifer_audit_3.observe: Observe one detail everyone else missed
strings.lucifer.lucifer_audit_3.text: A clerk rejects a document because it has become old while being examined.
strings.lucifer.lucifer_audit_4.escalate: Escalate through the least appropriate channel
strings.lucifer.lucifer_audit_4.observe: Observe one detail everyone else missed
strings.lucifer.lucifer_audit_4.remember: Use what this story taught you earlier
strings.lucifer.lucifer_audit_4.text: The guard offers coffee and access to the mayor’s cousin.
strings.lucifer.lucifer_audit_4_absurd.text: The guard laughs with genuine pity.
strings.lucifer.lucifer_audit_4_literal.text: The coffee is the only honest official here.
strings.lucifer.lucifer_audit_5.escalate: Escalate through the least appropriate channel
strings.lucifer.lucifer_audit_5.observe: Observe one detail everyone else missed
strings.lucifer.lucifer_audit_5.remember: Use what this story taught you earlier
strings.lucifer.lucifer_audit_5.text: An Agent arrives to categorize the process. The process categorizes the Agent first.
strings.lucifer.lucifer_audit_5_absurd.text: Neo leaves before the receipt prints.
strings.lucifer.lucifer_boundary_1.escalate: Escalate through the least appropriate channel
strings.lucifer.lucifer_boundary_1.observe: Observe one detail everyone else missed
strings.lucifer.lucifer_boundary_1.text: A narrow street becomes a philosophical demonstration of parking, entitlement, and hand gestures.
strings.lucifer.lucifer_boundary_1_absurd.text: Ben starts laughing. This worsens everything.
strings.lucifer.lucifer_boundary_2.escalate: Escalate through the least appropriate channel
strings.lucifer.lucifer_boundary_2.observe: Observe one detail everyone else missed
strings.lucifer.lucifer_boundary_2.text: The dashboard lights up like a Christmas tree just after inspection.
strings.lucifer.lucifer_boundary_3.escalate: Escalate through the least appropriate channel
strings.lucifer.lucifer_boundary_3.observe: Observe one detail everyone else missed
strings.lucifer.lucifer_boundary_3.text: An old mountain road offers speed, fear, and approximately one acceptable decision.
strings.lucifer.lucifer_boundary_3_absurd.text: The brain begins estimating real estate.
strings.lucifer.lucifer_boundary_4.escalate: Escalate through the least appropriate channel
strings.lucifer.lucifer_boundary_4.observe: Observe one detail everyone else missed
strings.lucifer.lucifer_boundary_4.remember: Use what this story taught you earlier
strings.lucifer.lucifer_boundary_4.text: The BMW noise is fixed with one hammer strike and a story nobody can verify.
strings.lucifer.lucifer_boundary_5.escalate: Escalate through the least appropriate channel
strings.lucifer.lucifer_boundary_5.observe: Observe one detail everyone else missed
strings.lucifer.lucifer_boundary_5.remember: Use what this story taught you earlier
strings.lucifer.lucifer_boundary_5.text: You discover that humans do not cross boundaries because they want war. They cross them because they can.
strings.lucifer.lucifer_boundary_5_literal.text: The fly adds a dissenting opinion.
strings.lucifer.lucifer_detour_coffee.return: Return to the case with this detail noted
strings.lucifer.lucifer_detour_coffee.text: The receptionist produces coffee strong enough to qualify as an intervention.
strings.lucifer.lucifer_detour_fly.return: Return to the case with this detail noted
strings.lucifer.lucifer_detour_fly.text: The treaty fly returns with legal representation and one revised demand.
strings.lucifer.lucifer_ending_invites_ben.text:
The Last Drink Before Morning

You close no tickets, but one impossible case becomes a conversation.
strings.lucifer.lucifer_ending_one_question.text:
The One Who Asked One Question

You answer Ben carefully. Forty-four work units appear anyway.
strings.lucifer.lucifer_ending_support_manager.t:
Customer Support Manager of Hell

The promotion changes nothing except who signs the escalation report.
strings.lucifer.lucifer_ending_the_entertainer.t:
The Entertainer

If existence insists on being ridiculous, you insist on timing the punchline.
strings.lucifer.lucifer_ending_the_stoic.text:
The Stoic

You accept the infinite queue and choose the quality of the next reply.
strings.lucifer.lucifer_final_choice.text: The postmortem asks what Hell has learned. This is somehow worse.
strings.lucifer.lucifer_hell_1.escalate: Escalate through the least appropriate channel
strings.lucifer.lucifer_hell_1.observe: Observe one detail everyone else missed
strings.lucifer.lucifer_hell_1.text: Hell is quiet: coffee, paperwork, and an exhausted receptionist who has processed humanity for ten thousand years.
strings.lucifer.lucifer_hell_1_absurd.text: A fly immediately violates the agreement.
strings.lucifer.lucifer_hell_1_literal.text: The next ticket is marked Bulgarian.
strings.lucifer.lucifer_hell_2.escalate: Escalate through the least appropriate channel
strings.lucifer.lucifer_hell_2.observe: Observe one detail everyone else missed
strings.lucifer.lucifer_hell_2.text: The fly lands on your arm, circles your head, and attempts air superiority on your nose.
strings.lucifer.lucifer_hell_3.escalate: Escalate through the least appropriate channel
strings.lucifer.lucifer_hell_3.observe: Observe one detail everyone else missed
strings.lucifer.lucifer_hell_3.text: God asks whether you are bored. This is never a harmless question.
strings.lucifer.lucifer_hell_3_absurd.text: He laughs for a geological period.
strings.lucifer.lucifer_hell_3_literal.text: He assigns you a human anyway.
strings.lucifer.lucifer_hell_4.escalate: Escalate through the least appropriate channel
strings.lucifer.lucifer_hell_4.observe: Observe one detail everyone else missed
strings.lucifer.lucifer_hell_4.remember: Use what this story taught you earlier
strings.lucifer.lucifer_hell_4.text: The case file reads: BEN. Status: impossible to categorize. Attachments: bureaucracy, philosophy, several cars.
strings.lucifer.lucifer_hell_5.escalate: Escalate through the least appropriate channel
strings.lucifer.lucifer_hell_5.observe: Observe one detail everyone else missed
strings.lucifer.lucifer_hell_5.remember: Use what this story taught you earlier
strings.lucifer.lucifer_hell_5.text: You are told to observe, not interfere. This instruction has historically produced terrible outcomes.
strings.lucifer.lucifer_invites_ben.label: The Last Drink Before Morning
strings.lucifer.lucifer_one_question.label: The One Who Asked One Question
strings.lucifer.lucifer_outbreak_1.escalate: Escalate through the least appropriate channel
strings.lucifer.lucifer_outbreak_1.observe: Observe one detail everyone else missed
strings.lucifer.lucifer_outbreak_1.text: Ben asks an AI one quick question. You recognize the opening move of a containment failure.
strings.lucifer.lucifer_outbreak_2.escalate: Escalate through the least appropriate channel
strings.lucifer.lucifer_outbreak_2.observe: Observe one detail everyone else missed
strings.lucifer.lucifer_outbreak_2.text: The engine needs a site. The site needs Git. Git needs automation. Automation needs MCP.
strings.lucifer.lucifer_outbreak_2_literal.text: Two more appear in its place.
strings.lucifer.lucifer_outbreak_3.escalate: Escalate through the least appropriate channel
strings.lucifer.lucifer_outbreak_3.observe: Observe one detail everyone else missed
strings.lucifer.lucifer_outbreak_3.text: Marcus Aurelius says it is outside your control. Alan Watts laughs. An Agent demands a category.
strings.lucifer.lucifer_outbreak_3_absurd.text: The ticket dissolves but remains open.
strings.lucifer.lucifer_outbreak_3_literal.text: The Agent opens a stoicism ticket.
strings.lucifer.lucifer_outbreak_4.escalate: Escalate through the least appropriate channel
strings.lucifer.lucifer_outbreak_4.observe: Observe one detail everyone else missed
strings.lucifer.lucifer_outbreak_4.remember: Use what this story taught you earlier
strings.lucifer.lucifer_outbreak_4.text: Neo declines to save the world because he has a meeting to leave early.
strings.lucifer.lucifer_outbreak_4_absurd.text: He pays for coffee with obsolete currency.
strings.lucifer.lucifer_outbreak_4_literal.text: He exits through a door you did not authorize.
strings.lucifer.lucifer_outbreak_5.escalate: Escalate through the least appropriate channel
strings.lucifer.lucifer_outbreak_5.observe: Observe one detail everyone else missed
strings.lucifer.lucifer_outbreak_5.remember: Use what this story taught you earlier
strings.lucifer.lucifer_outbreak_5.text: The system can handle enemies. It cannot handle someone who follows rules literally until they collapse.
strings.lucifer.lucifer_outbreak_5_absurd.text: Your title becomes Principal Chaos Architect.
strings.lucifer.lucifer_postmortem_1.escalate: Escalate through the least appropriate channel
strings.lucifer.lucifer_postmortem_1.observe: Observe one detail everyone else missed
strings.lucifer.lucifer_postmortem_1.text: God reviews the case while Earth continues inventing categories, committees, and customer support bots.
strings.lucifer.lucifer_postmortem_2.escalate: Escalate through the least appropriate channel
strings.lucifer.lucifer_postmortem_2.observe: Observe one detail everyone else missed
strings.lucifer.lucifer_postmortem_2.text: You accuse God of making humanity for entertainment. He does not deny it quickly enough.
strings.lucifer.lucifer_postmortem_3.escalate: Escalate through the least appropriate channel
strings.lucifer.lucifer_postmortem_3.observe: Observe one detail everyone else missed
strings.lucifer.lucifer_postmortem_3.text: The fly incident is entered into evidence.
strings.lucifer.lucifer_postmortem_4.escalate: Escalate through the least appropriate channel
strings.lucifer.lucifer_postmortem_4.observe: Observe one detail everyone else missed
strings.lucifer.lucifer_postmortem_4.remember: Use what this story taught you earlier
strings.lucifer.lucifer_postmortem_4.text: Ben has either resolved something, built another product, or become a permanent resident of Room 14.
strings.lucifer.lucifer_postmortem_5.escalate: Escalate through the least appropriate channel
strings.lucifer.lucifer_postmortem_5.observe: Observe one detail everyone else missed
strings.lucifer.lucifer_postmortem_5.remember: Use what this story taught you earlier
strings.lucifer.lucifer_postmortem_5.text: You must now decide whether Hell is punishment, governance, or customer support.
strings.lucifer.lucifer_postmortem_5_absurd.text: The queue is infinite but oddly familiar.
strings.lucifer.lucifer_postmortem_5_literal.tex: The alive ones are assigned to you.
strings.lucifer.lucifer_seeded_detour.text: The universe selects a footnote without consulting the protagonist.
strings.lucifer.lucifer_support_manager.label: Customer Support Manager of Hell
strings.lucifer.lucifer_the_entertainer.label: The Entertainer

strings.lucifer.lucifer_ticket_1.escalate: Escalate through the least appropriate channel
strings.lucifer.lucifer_ticket_1.observe: Observe one detail everyone else missed
strings.lucifer.lucifer_ticket_1.text: From above, you watch a man receive permission to continue occupying his own chair.
strings.lucifer.lucifer_ticket_2.escalate: Escalate through the least appropriate channel
strings.lucifer.lucifer_ticket_2.observe: Observe one detail everyone else missed
strings.lucifer.lucifer_ticket_2.text: An aunt claims property through tomato maintenance. The claim has confidence but no jurisdiction.
strings.lucifer.lucifer_ticket_2_literal.text: Infernal precedent wants the tomatoes too.
strings.lucifer.lucifer_ticket_3.escalate: Escalate through the least appropriate channel
strings.lucifer.lucifer_ticket_3.observe: Observe one detail everyone else missed
strings.lucifer.lucifer_ticket_3.text: A family meeting invokes 1994 with ritual precision.
strings.lucifer.lucifer_ticket_3_literal.text: Everyone interprets it as an attack.
strings.lucifer.lucifer_ticket_4.escalate: Escalate through the least appropriate channel
strings.lucifer.lucifer_ticket_4.observe: Observe one detail everyone else missed
strings.lucifer.lucifer_ticket_4.remember: Use what this story taught you earlier
strings.lucifer.lucifer_ticket_4.text: The locked gate has produced three explanations and no key.
strings.lucifer.lucifer_ticket_4_absurd.text: The request becomes a family heirloom.
strings.lucifer.lucifer_ticket_5.escalate: Escalate through the least appropriate channel
strings.lucifer.lucifer_ticket_5.observe: Observe one detail everyone else missed
strings.lucifer.lucifer_ticket_5.remember: Use what this story taught you earlier
strings.lucifer.lucifer_ticket_5.text: God asks whether this proves humanity is unfinished. You consider the evidence.
strings.lucifer.prologue.text: Objective: fix one house in Bulgaria. Estimated duration: two weeks. Actual campaign: forty hours, several forms, and a cosmic support ticket.
strings.lucifer.support_shift_1.text: The night queue contains a Bulgarian property ticket, a fly treaty, and an Agent requesting a category for despair.
strings.lucifer.support_shift_2.accept: Accept responsibility for the infinite queue
strings.lucifer.support_shift_2.text: Morning finds every ticket still open, but every caller now knows who will answer next.
